status_legend.cross_checked: Matches another report, or was recomputed from figures the report itself gives (arithmetic verified by the shadow).
status_legend.single_source: Appears in one report only; the underlying tool or page was not independently re-queried.
status_legend.conflict: Contradicted by, or not reconcilable with, another report or with the same report's own figures.
status_legend.unverified_secondary: Rests only on secondary media, WebSearch snippets, or an undated page; no primary filing was opened.
status_legend.stale: Based on a price or data point dated materially before 2026-11-23.
status_legend.data_quality_flagged: The author of the source report explicitly marked this figure as unreliable or unreconciled.
status_legend.gap: Absence claim: the report states that a search or data pull found nothing. Not evidence that the event did not occur.
status_legend.computed: A derived figure whose inputs are stated in the report; the shadow re-derived it. Inputs carry their own status.
